Sections, stable-first: (1) THE MAP — the richest areas at steering grain; (2) AREA INDEX — every other area, named, one line each; (3) ACTIVE SURFACE — recent + load-bearing witnesses; (4) FOCUS — material loaded for your focus, LAST. The map and index never vary with your focus; your per-call material is at the end.

^-marked entries are compressed stubs carrying child addresses. Their narration and any surfaced witness quotes are verbatim-accurate — quote them as-is — but a stub carries no provenance (source, date, supersession). Expand (aswritten_expand with the IRIs you need) before any claim that turns on WHEN or by WHOM something was said, or whether it is still the current framing. Witness-depth sections below already carry full provenance.

Deciding where to go: each mapped area's narration tells you the SPAN of what lives under it; the area index names everything else. Expand a subtree when its narration (or name) shows your subject plausibly lives there — you'll get the trajectory, the variants, and the verbatim witness. But be strict about absence: if neither the map's narrations nor the index's names substantively cover your subject, it is NOT in this perspective — say so rather than expanding a loose thematic match (a word-overlap is not coverage). Decide from the map; expand to ground.

positions.name: CalibrationVerifiedSettled
positions.frame: What standing does the Kestrelwood spectrograph's calibration hold once checked against the June reference plates — declared fact, or still an open question?
positions.why: All three expressions perform the same directional move: an unhedged, present-tense ratification that calibration at 88.4 MHz is complete and holds, verified against a named external standard (June reference plates). src-1 is the prose declaration in Quill's own voice; src-2 and src-3 restate the identical content as structured metadata fields, animated and authored by Xena on Quill's principal footing (fc-1) — a tension in delivery form (free prose vs. labelled-field) but not in direction: both register as native technical voice (register mint-1), both enact authority-ranking by deferring to the reference-plate standard rather than proposing or hedging, and both land at claim-level conviction with competence as the value in play. The group holds together as one settled-status reading even though the footing shifts from direct speech to animated record.

placements.why: This envelope's content — an observatory instrument's frequency calibration checked against dated reference plates — is organizationally distinct from the consulting-methodology decisions (Diagnostic First, Knowledge Mapping) that populate ns__Strategy in the existing map. Nothing in the supplied strata (currently empty) or existing structure covers instrument/measurement verification as an organizational category, and the perspective's own vocabulary names 'Calibration' as a recognized top-level stratum. Minting it foundational (no under) since it is a peer category to Strategy, not a child of it.

placements.why: All three expressions carry the same recurring subject future calibration envelopes will keep feeding: an instrument (Kestrelwood spectrograph) whose setting (88.4 MHz) is ratified as settled by verification against a named external standard (June reference plates), holding across the full observing band. src-1 is the prose statement of this in Quill's voice; src-2 and src-3 restate the identical content as structured metadata fields on the same footing. Per the grain test, the specific numbers (88.4 MHz, June plates) are the evidence, not the leaf — the leaf is the recurring theme of calibration-verified-against-standard that this and future observatory envelopes will accumulate under. Nothing in the supplied structure (empty) or the visible map (consulting-methodology decisions under ns__Strategy) plausibly holds this theme, so no reuse candidate exists.
